prompt: campaign has been live 6 days, 400 sends, no meetings, should I rewrite the copy

assertions.name: routes-to-ops-or-diagnose
assertions.check: Routes to gtm-outbound-ops (or diagnose with an explicit sample-size caveat)

assertions.name: refuses-early-verdict
assertions.check: States that 6 days / 400 sends is not enough to judge and names the ~21-day norm

assertions.name: blocks-premature-rewrite
assertions.check: Explicitly advises against rewriting copy on this evidence
